sourceIds: images/manifest.json — per-image releaseId + sourceUrl (esawebb.org/STScI official releases)
motions.purpose: Guide attention across a real James Webb Space Telescope image: smooth pan/zoom to numbered points of interest, each with an assertion caption sourced from the official release text.
motions.model: Critically damped spring camera (k=120, c=22) over the published JPEG; zoom springs in log space so a doubling feels equal at every level; points of interest are percent coordinates taken from official release captions.
motions.limitations: Display JPEGs, not calibrated FITS data; colors are the official representative-color compositions; point-of-interest notes quote release captions and are not independent measurements.
motions.reducedMotion: Camera jumps directly to targets; no springs, no inertia.
motions.exportState: Overview frame with all point-of-interest markers visible and the title caption; HUD hidden.
motions.accessibility: figure has role=application with keyboard control (arrows, 0, Escape); captions are aria-live; the required image credit is permanently visible.

sourceIds: images/manifest.json — pair entries with releaseId + sourceUrl (esawebb.org / esahubble.org official releases)
motions.purpose: Show what Webb adds over Hubble (or MIRI over NIRCam) on the same target with a draggable curtain: both real images share one camera, so every structure stays spatially locked while the observer wipes between them.
motions.model: Second published image of the same target drawn under a clipped region; curtain position is pointer-driven; entrance animates the curtain from the right edge with a critically damped spring (k=170, c=26).
motions.limitations: Images are aligned by frame, not astrometrically registered; small field-of-view and rotation differences between missions remain visible.
motions.reducedMotion: Curtain appears at 50% with no entrance animation.
motions.exportState: Curtain fixed at 50% with both instrument labels visible.
motions.accessibility: Curtain handle is large (22px hit area); both panes carry permanent text labels; comparison also operable from the demo toggle button.
